products.name: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
products.summary: L. Frank Baum's 1900 classic, first edition cover.
products.description:
Dorothy and her dog Toto are carried by a cyclone from Kansas to the Land of Oz. To get home she follows the yellow brick road to the Emerald City with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman and the Cowardly Lion.

This edition reproduces the original 1900 cover and colour plates by W. W. Denslow.

products.name: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
products.summary: Beatrix Potter's 1902 picture book, first edition cover.
products.description:
Peter Rabbit disobeys his mother, squeezes under the gate into Mr. McGregor's garden and has to run for his life among the cabbages and the cucumber frames.

Written and illustrated by Beatrix Potter, first published by Frederick Warne & Co. in 1902.
